Maya (CSM): Heads-up — Arcadia Analytics renewal flagged. Usage down ~62% last 30d after new ML lead joined. Customer mentioned evaluating NimbusAI POC. Need quick triage and playbook.
Jared (AE): Oof. When did they start the POC?
Maya (CSM): Sam said they kicked off last Wed. Spike in failed prompts + longer latencies reported by their data team the past 10 days.
Sam (Arcadia): Hey team — confirming. We trialed Nimbus for a month; some teams moved tests last week. Also seeing increased 5xx errors on a couple routes.
monitoring-bot: Alert: Arcadia service errors increased 4.8x over baseline (metric: request_5xx) — window: 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-18. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/arcadia-5xx
Ravi (SE): Can someone paste the route names and example error logs? I can check model variant + batching config.
Maya (CSM): Route names from Sam: /generate/prompt-analytics and /embed/batch. Sam attached a short log snippet.
Sam (Arcadia): Log excerpt:
```
2026-03-12T14:21:03Z ERROR handler.go:142 request_id=abc123 model=rw-3b quantized=true err="kvcache OOM"
2026-03-15T09:05:18Z ERROR handler.go:78 request_id=def456 code=502 upstream_timeout
```
Lina (PM): kvcache OOM could point to recent model variant we shipped last month (v2.3) — it uses denser attention kernels. Might need a fallback to v2.2 for that workload.
Ravi (SE): Agreed. Suggest immediate mitigation: pin customer to stable model v2.2 on Dedicated pool, and disable aggressive batching for /embed/batch for 48h. I can prepare a quick rollout.
Jared (AE): If we act fast we might stop their momentum to switch. Maya — can you ask for a short sync with their ML lead (Sam or proxy) tomorrow? I'll join.
Maya (CSM): Scheduling now. Proposed times: 2026-03-19 10:00 or 16:00 PT. Sam which works?
Sam (Arcadia): 10:00 PT works. Please include network diagram and expected latency after changes.
Ravi (SE): I'll prepare a change plan and expected latency numbers. Quick SQL to pull usage and error breakdown (for internal use):
```
SELECT route, count(*) as requests, sum(CASE WHEN status >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as errors
FROM request_logs
WHERE customer_id = 'arcadia' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY requests DESC;
```
Maya (CSM): Action items: 1) Ravi to draft rollback/ pin plan + latency estimates (eta: 2h). 2) Jared to prep renewal messaging and risk statement. 3) Lina to check whether v2.3 kernel change shipped to Dedicated pool — rollback gating. 4) Sam to share any recent internal tickets.
Lina (PM): I'll verify deployment state and whether v2.3 flags were enabled on their tenant. If yes, we can flip to v2.2 with no model weights transfer (quick).
Jared (AE): Also prepping a short commercial incentive (1 month discount on Dedicated) if they commit to stay for next quarter — we should not promise without finance sign-off but worth drafting.
Maya (CSM): Noted. I'll keep the meeting focused on technical mitigations first. If we stabilize, we can surface commercial options.
Sam (Arcadia): Appreciate the rapid response. Please send calendar invite and include the remediation plan in the invite.
Ravi (SE): Drafted mitigation checklist (short):
- Pin model -> v2.2 on arcadia-dedicated pool
- Disable continuous batching for /embed/batch (set max_batch_size=8)
- Increase KV cache quota for tenant by 30% temporarily
- Monitor request_5xx and tail latency for 24h
I'll drop configs in the meeting doc.
Maya (CSM): Thanks. I'll update this thread after the sync. If Ravi's mitigation looks good, we can execute immediately after the call. :thumbsup:
Jared (AE): I'll have a renewal risk summary ready (one-pager).
monitoring-bot: Next check scheduled in 30m.
Maya (CSM): Closing loop — meeting confirmed 2026-03-19 10:00 PT. Tagging @Lina @Ravi @Jared.
